android.desc:
BitWell - Wellness Support for Senior Living
BitWell is a non-medical wellness platform designed for senior living communities and families who want better day-to-day awareness of their parents' well-being. It helps caregivers and operators stay informed, organized, and proactive, without replacing medical care.
BitWell does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
KEY FEATURES
BUILT FOR SENIOR LIVING OPERATORS
Designed for assisted living spaces, retirement homes, and premium senior communities. BitWell helps staff and families stay aligned on residents' daily wellness and activity patterns.
FAMILY AWARENESS & CONNECTION
Allows families to stay informed about their parents' general well-being, reducing uncertainty and improving peace of mind - especially for those living remotely.
WELLNESS INSIGHTS (NON-MEDICAL)
Provides simple insights into activity, mobility, stability, and overall daily patterns to support better care and engagement.
FALL DETECTION ALERTS
Detects potential fall events and notifies caregivers or family members, enabling faster response and added safety for seniors.
RELIABLE HEALTH & LIFESTYLE KNOWLEDGE
Offers clear, verified information on aging, mobility, nutrition, and preventive lifestyle habits to support informed decisions.
BITWELL BAND INTEGRATION
BitWell integrates with the BitWell Band, an external wearable device, to provide additional wellness data such as heart rate, SpO2, mobility, stability, and fall detection.
IMPORTANT:

BitWell Band is not a medical device.
Fall detection and other data are indicative and may not be 100% accurate.
All data is for general wellness awareness only.
Not intended for medical diagnosis, monitoring, or treatment.
